paragraphs.text: LiFePO4 cathodes suffer from low rate capability.
Al2O3-coated LiFePO4 delivered 140 mAh g-1 at 1 C, whereas uncoated LiFePO4 delivered 110 mAh g-1 under the same conditions.
The authors suggest that the coating may suppress side reactions at the electrode surface.
In a separate LiFePO4 sample, Al2O3 coating reduced charge-transfer resistance.
The coated sample reached 125 mAh g-1 at 2 C.
No operando measurement of side reactions was reported.
